title: Undo history not cleared when opening a new/different file
description: clearHistory() is wired only to an explicit 'Clear History' button in the History panel (Shell.tsx:6388). When a new FLA is opened or a new document is created, clearHistory() is never called. The result: undo steps from the previous document remain in the stack, and Ctrl+Z after opening a file can restore old document state. Fix: call clearHistory() inside the handleOpenFile and handleNewDocument callbacks in Shell.tsx immediately after loading the new document.
